nodes.text: Is there an infinite graph $G$ which contains no $K_4$ and is not the union of countably many triangle-free graphs?

#595 : [Er87] graph theory | set theory A problem of Erdős and Hajnal. Folkman [Fo70] and Nešetřil and Rödl [NeRo75] have proved that for every $n\geq 1$ there is a graph $G$ which contains no $K_4$ and is not the union of $n$ triangle-free graphs. See also [582] and [596] .
